headline: Oil Prices Head for Weekly Drop Amid Easing Middle East Tensions
summary: Oil prices headed for a sharp weekly decline amid expectations of reduced tensions following political developments, though Middle East supply concerns maintained a price floor.
why: Crude oil is a primary global energy commodity whose price fluctuations directly impact energy sector equities, transportation costs, and headline inflation.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: Geopolitical risk premium reduction weighs directly on oil futures.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Easing geopolitical tensions in the Middle East reduced supply disruption fears, pushing crude futures lower for the week.
